name: Me dam
summary: Me dầm is the tamarind snack named beside cóc dầm on the sweet side of Con Market’s indoor counters, on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup. The page does not describe the dressing.
origin: Named at Con Market. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: The 2019 page names me dầm and does not describe a method. Check on arrival.
where: Indoor counters at Con Market. The 2019 roundup says to use the indoor court from 07:00 to 15:00. Later market pages do not restate that split.
